booleanOutcome.text: [[flag]] on {{declaration}} collapses every outcome into one bit, at the moment the distinction is cheapest to keep. [[repairAndWhy]]

repairAndWhy.TypeScript: Return a named outcome instead: a union of `outcome` members naming each way the operation can turn out, with the payload on the arm that carries it. Suggested name: {{suggested}}OutcomeType.
repairAndWhy.Swift: It also leaves the reader to know which other fields hold for which value of the flag. Return a named outcome instead: an enum with a case for each way the operation can turn out and the payload on the case that carries it, or Result, or a throw for the failure. Suggested name: {{suggested}}Outcome.
repairAndWhy.Go: It also leaves the reader to know which other fields hold for which value of the flag. Say the failure the way Go does instead: return the value and an error, or, when there are more than two ways the operation can turn out, give the outcome a named type with a constant for each and keep the payload beside it. Suggested name: {{suggested}}Outcome.
